checklist.notes: Past background actions, mediation of travel facts, and polite requests are each practised and combined in the final speaking task.
Form-focused items precede comprehension and a constrained integrated production task with analytic criteria.
The sequence generally rises from recognition and completion to reading/listening and then speaking.
Prompts identify required facts or forms and the final speaking constraints are explicit.
Short station contexts and a two-sentence production cap keep simultaneous grammar and pragmatic demands manageable.
Public-transport help scenarios are practical for Vietnamese learners and require respectful interaction without cultural overgeneralization.
Five short tasks with one bounded oral response are proportionate for A2.1.
